# Camz Cleaning

> Camz Cleaning is a professional residential and commercial cleaning company based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada, with 6+ years of experience. Services cover homes, offices, vehicles, and seasonal property care across Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane, and Chestermere.

## About

- Company: Camz Cleaning
- Location: Calgary, AB, Canada
- Service areas: Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane, Chestermere
- Experience: 6+ years
- Phone: +1 587-837-1977
- Email: info@camzcleaning.com
- Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM

## Services

- [Commercial Cleaning](https://camzcleaning.com/commercial-cleaning-services/): Cleaning for offices, restaurants, and facilities, including workstations, meeting rooms, restrooms, and floor maintenance.
- [Residential Cleaning](https://camzcleaning.com/residential-cleaning-services/): Home cleaning including dusting, vacuuming, room and bathroom sanitizing, floor care, plus furnace and duct cleaning.
- [Vehicle Cleaning](https://camzcleaning.com/vehicle-cleaning-service/): Interior vacuuming and detailing, seat and carpet cleaning, dashboard and glass care, and exterior wash.
- [Seasonal Property Service](https://camzcleaning.com/seasonal-property-service/): Year-round property care including snow removal, lawn care, and full property deep cleaning.
